lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: I'm back, and my hair is perfect.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Time to get my DOOSH on.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Another one bites the dust. Because I shot it.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Ow! That was my good arm!

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: I felt that in my hair.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: I've had worse. Not much worse.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Tell my hair I loved it.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Tell my mom I'm out of lives!

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: I'll be back. After a respawn.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Tell the shotgun I love her.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Hoisting the flag of freedom. And snacks.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: I love the smell of explosions in the morning.

lines.speaker: sgt
lines.text: Another day, another dollar, another explosion.

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Howdy, y'all! Pete's in the house!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: I'm little, but my guns are loud!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Nobody calls me short and lives!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Reload? I don't need to reload!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Look at me go! Pew pew pew pew!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Tell my horse I love him!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Checkpoint! Time for a tiny nap!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: Whoa, that's a big bang for a little guy!

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: I'm so bored I could eat my hat.

lines.speaker: pete
lines.text: That was a hoot and a half!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: THAT'S JUST A FLESH WOUND! A BIG ONE!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: TELL MY PROTEIN SHAKE I LOVE HIM!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: YOU'RE ON MY TEAM NOW, SOLDIER!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: CHECKPOINT! GET YOUR HEART RATE UP!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: WHY ARE WE STANDING AROUND?! MOVE!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: LET'S GO, LET'S GO, LET'S GO!

lines.speaker: brenda
lines.text: THAT'S A WRAP! GREAT SESSION, TEAM!

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Major Shhh, reporting. Do keep it down.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Jolly good shot, if I do say so myself.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Frightfully rude of you to stand there.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Shhh. No need to make a fuss.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: I say! What a spectacular mess!

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Do try to keep up, chaps.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Shhh. Do not panic. Panic quietly.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: I may be a tad bit dead soon.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Tell the Queen I was punctual.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Terribly sorry. Must dash. To the afterlife.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Jolly good to see you, old bean!

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: That was rather loud. My apologies.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Shhh. Do you hear that? No? Quite.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: I do wish someone would bring tea.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Shhh. Stealth is the name of the game. Mostly.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Another one in the bag. Shhh.

lines.speaker: major
lines.text: Shhh. We shall never speak of this.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Back in my day, we had two dimensions!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Back in my day, we shot them with rocks.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Not bad for a man of ninety-seven!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Ooh, a flamethrower! Just like the war!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Tell my cat I loved her.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: I see the light! Oh, wait, it's a lamp.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Well, don't just stand there, help an old man!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Thank goodness, I needed someone to carry my bags.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Hurry up, I'm not getting any younger!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: That's what I call a firecracker!

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Bah, back in my day explosions were bigger.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Pocket change! Don't mind if I do.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Where did I put my teeth?

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Are we done yet? I need my pills.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Let's get this over with, I've got bingo at five.

lines.speaker: gramps
lines.text: Now that's how we did it in 1952!

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: Sound the alarm! Wait, I am the alarm. AAAH!

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: Tell my wife... I was a goon.

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: Oh no, oh no, oh no!

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: Bad day to be a bad guy.

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: Medic! Oh wait, I'm the medic.

lines.speaker: goon
lines.text: That's gonna cost me my deposit!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Mount Ka-Blammo! Try not to melt!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Gustbuster Skyway! Hold on to your hats!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Soggy Bottom Docks! Don't forget your floaties!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Cornfed Plains! Beware of the cows!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Moon Base Bonkers! One small step for stick!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Ouch. That's gonna leave a mark.

lines.speaker: boss_ice
lines.text: Whoa. Chill out, little dude. Literally. I'm Frosty McChillface, and you're about to be a popsicle.

lines.speaker: boss_ice
lines.text: Dude. You're on thin ice. And I brought a snowmobile.

lines.speaker: boss_ice
lines.text: My scarf! You got my tiny scarf!

lines.speaker: boss_fire
lines.text: I'm Captain Combustion! I put out fires! And I'm on fire! This is fine!

lines.speaker: boss_fire
lines.text: Hello! Don't mind the flames! I'm professionally on fire!

lines.speaker: boss_fire
lines.text: Stop, drop, and roll... oh, I can't.

lines.speaker: boss_fire
lines.text: Finally, a break from the heat.

lines.speaker: boss_wind
lines.text: Hear that? That's the sound of my mighty lungs! Gustav Blowhard will blow you away!

lines.speaker: boss_wind
lines.text: Hooo! Time to clear the air!

lines.speaker: boss_wind
lines.text: Pffff! You knocked the wind out of me!

lines.speaker: boss_wind
lines.text: Now I'm gonna huff, and puff, and blow your face off!

lines.speaker: boss_water
lines.text: Arrr! Admiral Soggybottom be here! Me bathtub be mighty, and me bottom be soggy!

lines.speaker: boss_water
lines.text: Avast, ye landlubbers! Prepare to be rinsed!

lines.speaker: boss_water
lines.text: Now ye've made me tub angry!

lines.speaker: boss_water
lines.text: Pull the plug! No, don't pull the plug!

lines.speaker: boss_water
lines.text: Down the drain I go... glug glug...

lines.speaker: boss_mud
lines.text: I say. Sir Sludgington, if you please. You've tracked mud on my carpet. Which is me.

lines.speaker: boss_mud
lines.text: Good evening. Prepare to be squelched.

lines.speaker: boss_mud
lines.text: Now I'm positively filthy with rage!

lines.speaker: boss_jungle
lines.text: OOK OOK! CHIMPANZILLA SMASH TINY STICK!

lines.speaker: boss_jungle
lines.text: Ook! You come to my temple? Bad idea! Ook!

lines.speaker: boss_jungle
lines.text: NOW CHIMPANZILLA ANGRY! OOK OOK OOK!

lines.speaker: boss_jungle
lines.text: Me chest drum now! Bom bom bom!

lines.speaker: boss_jungle
lines.text: Ooook... tell the monkeys... I loved them...

lines.speaker: boss_mountain
lines.text: Baaa! I'm Billy the Kidd, king of the mountain, and I'm the G.O.A.T.!

lines.speaker: boss_mountain
lines.text: Bleat this, stick boy! Baaa ha ha!

lines.speaker: boss_mountain
lines.text: I'm gonna ram you so hard!

lines.speaker: boss_plains
lines.text: Howdy, varmint. Colonel Cornhusk. I'm gonna harvest ya like corn.

lines.speaker: boss_plains
lines.text: This here's my field, and that there's my combine. Y'all are about to get thrashed.

lines.speaker: boss_plains
lines.text: Now I'm stuffed with rage! And straw!

lines.speaker: boss_fantasy
lines.text: Behold! I am Wizzlebeard the Wise, and my beard is mightier than your gun!

lines.speaker: boss_fantasy
lines.text: Fools! You dare enter my castle? Prepare to be turned into a toad!

lines.speaker: boss_fantasy
lines.text: Now you've done it! I shall conjure my TINY DRAGON!

lines.speaker: boss_fantasy
lines.text: My beard... was my power... all along...

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: Greetings, Earth stick. I am Emperor Zorp. Resistance is futile. Also, a little bit funny.

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: Bow before Zorp, ruler of the Moon! Which is made of cheese. Probably.

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: My UFO! You dented my UFO!

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: Activate mech arms! All of them!

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: Zorp will return... in a better UFO...

lines.speaker: boss_moon
lines.text: Take me to your leader... of the afterlife.

lines.speaker: boss_retro
lines.text: ERROR. PLAYER DETECTED. INITIATING GLITCH DOT EXE.

lines.speaker: boss_retro
lines.text: FATAL ERROR. UPGRADING TO PHASE TWO.

lines.speaker: boss_fortress
lines.text: At last, we meet. I am General Doom-Doosh. Yes, I'm Sergeant Doosh's evil twin. My goatee is evil.

lines.speaker: boss_fortress
lines.text: Welcome to the DOOSHINATOR! Prepare for DOOM. And also DOOSH!

lines.speaker: boss_fortress
lines.text: Now I will unleash the full power of the DOOSHINATOR!

lines.speaker: boss_fortress
lines.text: Tell my goatee... I loved it...
